svg.title: The folds stay. The crossings change.
svg.desc: Three equal-scale sevenfold orbital drawings have 7, 21, and 35 crossing pairs at backward-arm phases zero, 0.65 pi, and pi. A complete staircase has seven simultaneous quadratic touches at phase 0.341592 pi, then seven more at 0.951536 pi. The fourteenfold staircase rises from 70 to 98 to 126 pairs, at phases 0.914297 pi and 0.962912 pi; its axis shows only the last eleven percent of the half-turn. Three enlarged separation graphs show the first sevenfold gap before, near, and after its touch. Two zeros enclose a newly opened lens. The graph axes have different scales. The contact census is certified; plotted geometry is numerical. Pair counts include three pairs at a triple visit.

g.text: The folds stay.
The crossings change.
Turn the backward arm from zero to a half turn. Keep all three lengths.

Seven folds · two batches of seven touches
Each batch adds fourteen transverse crossing pairs.
Fourteen folds · two batches of fourteen touches
The count stays 70 through 0.89. Enlarge the last part of the turn:
Both horizontal axes: fraction of a half turn, φ / π
Subtract two branches. Watch a lens open.
First sevenfold touch · along-tangent range ±4 · normal range −0.12 to +0.36
The normal scale is enlarged. These are selected-branch separation graphs.
Before
Touch · approximate
After
At the touch the gap kisses zero. Just after, two zeros bound a little lens.
All seven rotated copies do this together. Both tracing points keep moving.
